title: Minecon Logo Title
description: This pack replaces the default game title with a Minecon title (on the title screen)
body:
**This pack replaces the default Minecraft title with the old Minecon logo,** visible on the title screen.

![Minecon Logo Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0589afab9beabf02739e0cd6fa1617121f25f13c_0.webp)

## 🔩 Supports:
- 1.21.9+
- Would NOT work if another pack that changes the **title logo** is ABOVE this pack on the pack list.
